title: Language models recognize dropout and Gaussian noise applied to their activations
abstract: arXiv:2604.17465v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We provide evidence that language models can detect, localize and, to a degree, verbalize the difference between a-semantic perturbations applied to their activations. More precisely, we either (a) apply dropout or (b) add Gaussian noise to them, at a target sentence. We then ask a multiple-choice question such as "Which of the previous sentences was perturbed?" or "Which perturbation was applied?". We test eight models from the Gemma, Llama, Mistral, Olmo, Qwen and Seed families, with sizes between 8B and 36B, all of which can easily detect and localize the perturbations, often with perfect accuracy. To investigate the mechanisms, we find that Olmo models develop this capacity during pre-training, and we rule out the hypothesis that perturbed sentences simply have lower log-likelihood. Notably, the zero-shot accuracy of Qwen3-32B and Qwen3.8-27B in identifying which perturbation was applied correlates with the perturbation strength.

translated_title: 语言模型能够识别作用于其激活值的dropout和 高斯噪声
translated_abstract: 我们提供了证据表明，语言模型能够检测、定位并在一定程度上用语言表述作用于其激活值的非语义扰动。更具体地说，我们在目标句子上或者施加dropout，或者添加高斯噪声。然后我们提出多项选择题，例如“前面的哪句话被扰动了？”或“施加了哪种扰动？”。我们测试了来自Gemma、Llama、Mistral、Olmo、Qwen和Seed家族的八个模型，规模介于8B到36B之间，所有模型都能轻松检测和定位这些扰动，且常常达到完美准确率。为了探究其机制，我们发现Olmo模型在预训练过程中逐渐发展出这种能力，并且我们排除了“被扰动句子仅仅具有更低对数似然”这一假设。值得注意的是，Qwen3-32B和Qwen3.8-27B在识别施加了哪种扰动方面的零样本准确率与扰动强度相关。
tldr: 研究发现主流大语言模型（8B至36B规模）能够以极高甚至完美的准确率检测、定位并区分施加于其自身激活值的dropout和高斯噪声扰动，该能力在预训练中形成，且零样本识别准确率与扰动强度相关。
en_tdlr: Large language models (8B-36B) can detect, localize, and identify dropout and Gaussian noise perturbations applied to their own activations with near-perfect accuracy; this ability emerges during pre-training, and zero-shot identification accuracy correlates with perturbation strength.
